spec.description: kube-image-keeper: routing, mirroring and monitoring of container images. One tab per concern, general to specific.

spec.title: Replicas up
spec.description: Targets answering their scrapes, per process.

spec.expr: count without (instance, pod, endpoint, service) (up{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"} == 1 and on (cluster, instance) max_over_time(kuik_build_info{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"}[1h]))

spec.title: Leader
spec.description: Whether a replica of each elected process (reconciler, secret syncer) holds its lease.

spec.expr: max without (instance, pod, endpoint, service) (leader_election_master_status{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"} and on (cluster, instance) kuik_build_info{cluster="$cluster"})

spec.title: Config rejected
spec.description: Replicas running a previous global config because they refused the one mounted. Their logs say why.

spec.expr: count without (instance, pod, endpoint, service) (kuik_config_last_reload_successful{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"} == 0)

spec.title: Version
spec.description: The kuik version from kuik_build_info. Several values during a rollout.

spec.expr: max by (version) (kuik_build_info{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"})

spec.title: Non-Ready
spec.description: Resources whose Ready condition is False.

spec.expr: count(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_resource_not_ready{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}))

spec.title: Rings behind
spec.description: Rings whose current lap has run more than 3 × its shared lap, images × rings on the host × check interval: their images are no longer checked. The Pacing tab names them.

spec.expr: count((time() - max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_check_cycle_started_timestamp_seconds{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"})) / (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_check_ring_images{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"}) * ignoring (kind, name) group_left count without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, kind, name) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_check_ring_images{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry"}) > 0) * ignoring (kind, name, operation) group_left max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_registry_interval_seconds{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry", operation="Check"})) > 3)

spec.title: Copies missing
spec.description: References the selected mirrors want at their destination and do not hold: copies pending or failing. The Mirror tab names the failing ones.

spec.expr: sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMirror", reference="copy", state="unavailable"}))

spec.title: Copies held / wanted
spec.description: Share of the wanted references the destinations hold, every mirror together. Below 100 % while copies are pending or failing; retained references count as wanted.

spec.expr: (sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMirror", reference="copy", state="available"})) or 0 * sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMirror", reference="copy"}))) / (sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMirror", reference="copy"})) > 0)

spec.title: Images tracked
spec.description: References tracked by the selected resources, every state summed. Selectors may overlap: an image counts once per resource tracking it.

spec.expr: sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}))

spec.title: Origins unavailable
spec.description: Origins whose last check failed: images the cluster runs that the upstream no longer serves or refuses. The Monitor tab names them.

spec.expr: sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMonitor", reference="origin", state="unavailable"}))

spec.title: Origins unavailable rate
spec.description: unavailable: share of the checked origins whose last check failed. checked: share of the tracked origins checked since the reconciler started; below 100 % after a restart, the rate then covers only that part.

spec.expr: (sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMonitor", reference="origin", state="unavailable"})) or 0 * sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMonitor", reference="origin"}))) / (sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMonitor", reference="origin"})) > 0)

(sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMonitor", reference="origin"})) or 0 * sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMonitor", reference="origin"}))) / (sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMonitor", reference="origin"})) > 0)

spec.title: Status lists ≥ 80 %
spec.description: Status lists 80 % full or more: they will soon leave entries out, the metrics stay complete. The Processes tab names them.

spec.expr: count(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_status_list_entries{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}) / max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_status_list_capacity{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}) >= 0.8)

spec.title: Containers rewritten
spec.description: Containers of live pods running the reference kuik rewrote them to. The Routing tab splits them by resource.

spec.expr: sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_routing_containers{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", state="rewritten"}))

spec.title: Containers conceded or stale
spec.description: Containers whose rewrite no longer holds: replaced by another webhook (conceded) or edited after admission (stale). The Routing tab names the pods.

spec.expr: sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_routing_containers{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", state=~"conceded|stale"}))

spec.title: Resources by kind
spec.description: Resources kuik reports on, by kind, counted from the series they export. A resource not reconciled yet is not counted.

spec.expr: count without (name) (count without (state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, job) (kuik_routing_containers{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"})) or count without (reference, state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, job) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"})) or max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, job, reason) (kuik_resource_not_ready{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}))

spec.title: Anomalies by family
spec.description: Anomalies per family, largest first; empty while nothing is broken. Families overlap, so the counts do not add up.

spec.title: Everything broken
spec.description: Every anomaly of the selected resources, grouped by family; the anomaly tables of each tab show the same entries with their detail.

spec.expr:
label_replace(max by (kind, name, reason) (kuik_resource_not_ready{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "family", "not ready", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (kind, name, image, registry, reason) (kuik_image_origin_unavailable{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "family", "unavailable origins", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (kind, name, image, registry, derived_from, via, reason) (kuik_image_alternative_unavailable{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "family", "unusable alternatives", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (kind, name, image, registry, reason) (kuik_image_copy_failed{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "family", "failed copies", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (kind, name, image, registry) (kuik_image_drifted{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMirror"}), "family", "copy drift", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (kind, name, image, registry) (kuik_alternatives_exhausted_pods{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "family", "candidates exhausted", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (kind, name, image, registry) (kuik_fallback_active_pods{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "family", "active fallbacks", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (kind, name, image, registry) (kuik_rewrite_conceded_pods{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "family", "conceded rewrites", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (kind, name, image, registry) (kuik_rewrite_stale_pods{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "family", "stale rewrites", "", "")

spec.title: Requests by host and result (time range)
spec.description: Requests sent to each source registry over the time range, by result, and the share without an Ok. The volume follows the pacing: read which results a host answers, not how many. ManifestNotFound counts as a failure.

spec.expr: sum by (registry, result) (increase(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry"}[$__range])) or label_replace((sum by (registry) (increase(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry", result!="Ok"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (registry) (increase(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry"}[$__range]))) / (sum by (registry) (increase(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry"}[$__range])) > 0), "result", "Failure", "", "")

spec.title: Failure rate by host
spec.description: Share of the requests to each host without an Ok, over time: green when all succeed, orange from the first failure, red from one in two. A window without any request keeps the previous state.

spec.expr: (sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, job, operation, result) (rate(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry", result!="Ok"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, job, operation, result) (rate(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, job, operation, result) (rate(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

spec.title: Containers by state
spec.description: Containers of the pods each resource selects, by state, as a share (untouched in grey). The tooltip gives the counts.

spec.expr: label_join(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_routing_containers{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "resource", "/", "kind", "name")

spec.title: Reach vs scope
spec.description: Live pods each resource selects (scope), those carrying a rewrite by it (reach), and the ratio. Under Always near 100 % is nominal; under OnFailure near 0 % is.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name) (kuik_routing_pods_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"})
max by (kind, name) (kuik_routing_pods_rewritten{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"})

(max by (kind, name) (kuik_routing_pods_rewritten{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}) or 0 * max by (kind, name) (kuik_routing_pods_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"})) / (max by (kind, name) (kuik_routing_pods_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}) > 0)

spec.title: Rewritten containers, cluster
spec.description: Containers carrying a rewrite across the selected resources, by state: rewritten, conceded to another webhook, stale after an edit.

spec.expr: sum without (kind, name) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_routing_containers{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", state=~"rewritten|conceded|stale"}))

spec.title: Pods rewritten
spec.description: Live pods each resource selects that carry a rewrite by it, as a share (others in grey). Under Always a short green bar is an incident; under OnFailure a long one means origins did not answer.

spec.expr: label_join(label_replace(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_routing_pods_rewritten{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "state", "rewritten", "", "") or label_replace(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_routing_pods_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}) - max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_routing_pods_rewritten{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}), "state", "not rewritten", "", ""), "resource", "/", "kind", "name")

spec.title: Rewrites by policy
spec.description: Container images rewritten at admission per second, by resource and policy (Always, OnFailure). Exported by the webhook: a counter of decisions, not of running pods.

spec.expr: sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(kuik_routing_rewrites_total{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Exhausted vs rewrites
spec.description: Containers left untouched at admission because no candidate answered, per resource, against the rewrites of the same resources.

spec.expr: sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(kuik_routing_alternatives_exhausted_total{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(kuik_routing_rewrites_total{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Candidates exhausted
spec.description: Live pods whose image no candidate served at admission: they run from a node cache or not at all. Hidden when empty.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, image, registry) (kuik_alternatives_exhausted_pods{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"})

spec.title: Active fallbacks
spec.description: Live pods running on a fallback instead of their origin under rewritePolicy OnFailure, by resource. Hidden when empty.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, image, registry) (kuik_fallback_active_pods{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"})

spec.title: Conceded rewrites
spec.description: Live pods whose rewrite another mutating webhook replaced: kuik stood down. Narrow one of the two scopes. Hidden when empty.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, image, registry) (kuik_rewrite_conceded_pods{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"})

spec.title: Stale rewrites
spec.description: Live pods whose rewritten container was edited after admission: kuik no longer acts on it. Roll the workload. Hidden when empty.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, image, registry) (kuik_rewrite_stale_pods{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"})

spec.title: Held / wanted
spec.description: Share of the references each mirror wants that its destination holds. Below 100 % while copies are pending or failing; retained references count as wanted.

spec.expr: (sum without (reference, state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="copy", state="available"})) or 0 * sum without (reference, state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="copy"}))) / (sum without (reference, state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="copy"})) > 0)

spec.title: Self-check freshness
spec.description: Time since the last complete destination pass of each mirror. Orange past one mirror.destinationScan.interval, red past three, read from the configuration kuik exports.

spec.expr: time() - max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_mirror_self_checked_timestamp_seconds{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"})

3 * max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, registry, operation) (kuik_registry_interval_seconds{cluster="$cluster", operation="Scan"}) and count without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, kind, name) (kuik_mirror_self_checked_timestamp_seconds{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"})

spec.title: Missing sources
spec.description: Images a mirror wants that no source can supply any more: pods still running them depend on a node cache.

spec.expr: count(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_image_copy_failed{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry", reason="SourceNotFound"}))

spec.title: Orphan tags
spec.description: Tags of this cluster at the destinations that no tracked reference explains, kept until their retention elapses. A count that keeps growing means something writes there outside kuik.

spec.expr: sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_mirror_tags_orphan{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}))

spec.title: Copies by reason
spec.description: Images pushed per second, by mirror and reason: Initial, Recopy (copy went missing), Resync (upstream digest moved).

spec.expr: sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(kuik_mirror_copies_total{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Recopies (last hour)
spec.description: Copies made again in the last hour because the destination no longer held them: something deletes there outside kuik, while pods may be routed to it. Any value above 0 is a signal.

spec.expr: sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (increase(kuik_mirror_copies_total{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reason="Recopy"}[1h]))

spec.title: Deletions by reason
spec.description: Tags deleted at the destination per second, by mirror and reason: Unused (retention elapsed) or Orphan.

spec.expr: sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(kuik_mirror_tags_deleted_total{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Copy duration
spec.description: Distribution of how long one copy takes. Empty until metrics.copyDuration is true in the global config (off by default).

spec.expr: sum without (kind, name) (sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(kuik_mirror_copy_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Copy duration quantiles
spec.description: p50, p95 and p99 of how long one copy takes. Empty until metrics.copyDuration is true in the global config.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum without (kind, name) (sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(kuik_mirror_copy_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}[$__rate_interval]))))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum without (kind, name) (sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(kuik_mirror_copy_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}[$__rate_interval]))))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum without (kind, name) (sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(kuik_mirror_copy_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}[$__rate_interval]))))

spec.title: Unrecoverable images
spec.description: Images a mirror wants that no source can supply any more: the origin and every alternative answer SourceNotFound. The registry column is the source that answered. Hidden when empty.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, image, registry, reason) (kuik_image_copy_failed{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry", reason="SourceNotFound"})

spec.title: Failing copies
spec.description: Images whose copy fails for another reason; registry is the side that failed. Keep the Registry dropdown on All to see destination failures; the Reason dropdown does not apply. Hidden when empty.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, image, registry, reason) (kuik_image_copy_failed{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry", reason!="SourceNotFound"})

spec.title: Copy drift
spec.description: Tags whose upstream digest moved away from the copy, under driftPolicy Warn, and briefly under Sync until the resync. The image column is the origin reference. Hidden when empty.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, image, registry) (kuik_image_drifted{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry", kind="ImageMirror"})

spec.title: Tracked population
spec.description: References the selected monitors track, by reference and state. An image counts once per monitor tracking it.

spec.expr: sum without (kind, name) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference!="copy"}))

spec.title: Ring coverage
spec.description: Share of the tracked references checked since the reconciler started. Below 100 % after a restart, until every ring has turned: the unavailability rate is partial until then.

spec.expr: (sum without (state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="origin"})) or 0 * sum without (state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="origin"}))) / (sum without (state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="origin"})) > 0)

(sum without (state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="alternatives"})) or 0 * sum without (state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="alternatives"}))) / (sum without (state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="alternatives"})) > 0)

spec.title: Unavailability rate
spec.description: Share of the checked references whose last check failed, by reference. Partial after a restart: read it with the ring coverage.

spec.expr: (sum without (kind, name, state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="origin", state="unavailable"})) or 0 * sum without (kind, name, state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="origin"}))) / (sum without (kind, name, state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="origin"})) > 0)

(sum without (kind, name, state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="alternatives", state="unavailable"})) or 0 * sum without (kind, name, state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="alternatives"}))) / (sum without (kind, name, state) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference="alternatives"})) > 0)

spec.title: Verdicts over time
spec.description: Checked references by verdict of their last check, stacked: the only availability history kuik exports.

spec.expr: sum without (kind, name, reference) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference!="copy"}))

spec.title: Retention growing
spec.description: References no live pod runs any more, kept for their retention, by monitor and reference. A count that only grows means images rotate faster than the retention lets go of them.

spec.expr: max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_tracked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", reference!="copy", state="retained"})

spec.title: Unavailable origins
spec.description: Origins whose last check failed, grouped by reason. Many entries on one registry point at the host, its quota or credentials rather than one image. Hidden when empty.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, image, registry, reason) (kuik_image_origin_unavailable{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry", reason=~"$reason"})

spec.title: Unusable alternatives
spec.description: Alternatives whose last check failed: derived_from is the origin, via the ImageAlternative offering it. Fix Unauthorized with credentials in its auth or in fallbackAuth. Hidden when empty.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, image, registry, derived_from, via, reason) (kuik_image_alternative_unavailable{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry", reason=~"$reason"})

spec.title: How pacing works
spec.description: How kuik paces its requests to each registry, and how to read the Rings table.

options.content:
kuik sends at most one request per window to each registry (`check.interval`, `copy.interval`), to stay under its quota.

Each resource checks its images in a **ring** per host, one image per window: alone on its host, a lap lasts images × interval. The rings of a host take its windows in turn, so with n rings a lap lasts up to n times that: the shared lap. The Rings table compares the last lap and the lap in progress of each ring with its shared lap: up to 100 % the ring keeps pace, above it lost windows.

Reference: [Registry pacing](https://kuik.enix.io/concepts/pacing/).

spec.title: Rings
spec.description: One row per registry: its check interval, how many rings share it, their images and the worst of their ratios. Unfold a registry for its rings, one per resource checking images there. The rings of a host take its check windows in turn: the shared lap, images × rings on the host × check interval, is the longest a lap takes without lost windows. Up to 100 % of it the ring keeps pace, above it the ring lost windows; a lap in progress past 300 % is a stuck ring.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_ring_images{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"})

max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_ring_images{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"}) * 0 + on (registry) group_left max by (registry) (kuik_registry_interval_seconds{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry", operation="Check"})
max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_cycle_duration_seconds{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"})

max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_cycle_duration_seconds{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"}) / (max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_ring_images{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"}) * on (registry) group_left count by (registry) (max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_ring_images{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry"}) > 0) * on (registry) group_left max by (registry) (kuik_registry_interval_seconds{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry", operation="Check"}))
(time() - max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_cycle_started_timestamp_seconds{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"}))

(max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_ring_images{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"}) * on (registry) group_left count by (registry) (max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_ring_images{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry"}) > 0) * on (registry) group_left max by (registry) (kuik_registry_interval_seconds{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry", operation="Check"}))

spec.title: Last lap duration
spec.description: Duration of the last completed lap of each ring, longest first. A ring shows nothing until its first lap completes.

spec.expr: label_join(label_join(max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_cycle_duration_seconds{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"}), "resource", "/", "kind", "name"), "ring", " on ", "resource", "registry")

spec.title: Ring size
spec.description: Images each ring turns over, and its share of every ring.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, registry) (kuik_check_ring_images{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", registry=~"$registry"})

spec.title: Configured intervals
spec.description: Intervals loaded from the global config. Check and Copy, per source registry: one request per window. Scan, per mirror destination: the period of the self-check pass (mirror.destinationScan.interval).

spec.expr: max by (registry, operation) (kuik_registry_interval_seconds{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry"})

spec.title: Copy budget saturation (last hour)
spec.description: Share of the copy windows of each source host used over the last hour. A successful window sends 2 Ok requests, the source check and the manifest read, so the Ok requests are halved: a failed window counts 0 or 0.5, which underestimates, never overstates. Only meaningful with a backlog: above 95 % with one, only a shorter copy.interval drains it.

spec.expr: (sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, job, result) (rate(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry", operation="Copy", result="Ok"}[1h])) * ignoring (operation) group_left max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, job) (kuik_registry_interval_seconds{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry", operation="Copy"})) / 2

spec.title: Mirror backlog
spec.description: Copies the selected mirrors still owe their destination, whatever the source host.

spec.expr: sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (kuik_images_checked{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name", kind="ImageMirror", state="unavailable"}))

spec.title: Failed requests (time range)
spec.description: Requests without an Ok over the time range, by host, operation and result, and their share of that operation's requests to the host: what wastes the windows of a host.

spec.expr: round(sum by (registry, operation, result) (increase(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry", result!="Ok"}[$__range]))) > 0

sum by (registry, operation, result) (increase(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry", result!="Ok"}[$__range])) / ignoring (result) group_left sum by (registry, operation) (increase(kuik_registry_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", registry=~"$registry"}[$__range])) > 0

spec.title: Admission latency (time range)
spec.description: p50, p95 and p99 of the time the webhook takes to answer, over the time range; empty without any admission. Under OnFailure it includes the origin probe, bounded by webhook.availabilityCheck.timeout.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, webhook) (increase(controller_runtime_webhook_latency_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))) >= 0

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, webhook) (increase(controller_runtime_webhook_latency_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))) >= 0

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, webhook) (increase(controller_runtime_webhook_latency_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))) >= 0

spec.title: Rate and codes
spec.description: Admission requests per second, by HTTP code. Anything but 200 is a failed admission: the webhook fails open, so the pod is created without routing.

spec.expr: sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, webhook) (rate(controller_runtime_webhook_requests_total{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Reconcile errors
spec.description: Reconciliations that returned an error per second, by controller: retried with backoff, statuses stale meanwhile. The reconciler logs say why.

spec.expr: sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_errors_total{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Workqueues
spec.description: Items waiting per workqueue (depth, left axis) and age of the oldest item in progress (right axis). Minutes in progress means a reconciliation hangs, usually on a registry.

spec.expr: max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (workqueue_depth{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"})
max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (workqueue_unfinished_work_seconds{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"})

spec.title: Applies by result
spec.description: Pull Secret applies per second, by result: Applied when something changed, Noop otherwise, Failed. Healthy is mostly Noop, after a burst of Applied at start.

spec.expr: sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(kuik_secret_applies_total{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Applied ratio
spec.description: Share of the applies that changed something. Above 0.5 for two hours, something undoes what kuik writes; the burst after a start passes.

spec.expr: (sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, result) (rate(kuik_secret_applies_total{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job", result="Applied"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, result) (rate(kuik_secret_applies_total{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service, result) (rate(kuik_secret_applies_total{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

spec.title: Failures (last hour)
spec.description: Pull Secret applies that failed in the last hour: pods in those namespaces will fail to pull.

spec.expr: sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (increase(kuik_secret_applies_total{cluster="$cluster", job=~"$job", result="Failed"}[1h]))

spec.title: Fill by list
spec.description: Entries of each status list over its cap of 500, fullest first.

spec.expr: max by (kind, name, list) (kuik_status_list_entries{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}) / max by (kind, name, list) (kuik_status_list_capacity{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"})

spec.title: Dropped entries (last hour)
spec.description: Entries a status list could not hold in the last hour: kubectl no longer shows every anomaly, the metrics do. Split the resource or fix what fills the list.

spec.expr: sum without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (increase(kuik_status_list_dropped_total{cluster="$cluster", kind=~"$kind", name=~"$name"}[1h]))
